annotation.title_clean: Act on Promotion of Research and Development, and Utilization of Artificial Intelligence-related Technology
annotation.title_en: Act on Promotion of Research and Development, and Utilization of Artificial Intelligence-related Technology
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Diet of Japan (Japanese Law Translation, Ministry of Justice)
annotation.summary_en: Japan's 2025 AI Promotion Act is a framework statute setting basic principles, responsibilities of government, local authorities, researchers, businesses and citizens, an AI Basic Plan, and an AI Strategic Headquarters. It prioritises innovation and competitiveness, with soft duties on transparency and study of rights infringements. It has no robotics-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines basic principles: competitiveness, comprehensive R&D promotion, international cooperation.
Calls for transparency and measures against misuse (crime, personal data leaks, copyright infringement).
Government to investigate infringement cases and give guidance and advice to businesses.
Requires a national AI Basic Plan (Art. 18).
Establishes an AI Strategic Headquarters in the Cabinet (Ch. IV).
